description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs. 

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

 

What You’ll Do

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to build and lead Horizon3’s Developer Experience (DevEx) team. DevEx makes it fast, safe, and easy for engineers to get a change from local development through build, test, and release. The team owns the shared developer workflows and delivery foundations that product teams consume—not the product code or service outcomes those workflows support.

You will:

  • Build, coach, and grow a high-performing Developer Experience team. Set clear expectations, provide regular feedback, support career development, manage performance, and create an inclusive, psychologically safe environment where the team can do its best work.

  • Own the team’s strategy, quarterly roadmap, and delivery commitments. Balance developer-facing improvements with operational health, security, support, migrations, and technical debt; make capacity and trade-offs visible.

  • Treat developer workflows as a product: learn where engineers encounter friction, prioritize the highest-value shared problems, establish clear platform contracts, and drive adoption through usable defaults, documentation, migration support, and feedback.

  • Lead the evolution of the path from repository checkout to production release, including local development, onboarding, repository templates, CI/CD infrastructure, build and test systems, runner configuration, artifact promotion, release manifests, deployment mechanics, gates, and rollback paths.

  • Improve build and pipeline speed, reliability, and feedback quality. Establish useful measures for pipeline health, queue and cycle time, release performance, adoption, and developer experience.

  • Establish sustainable practices for shared container base images, dependency hygiene, reproducible builds, scanning, signing, provenance, and software supply-chain security in partnership with Security and service teams.

  • Promote responsible use of approved AI-assisted development workflows. Ensure generated code receives human review and the same testing, quality, and security checks as other code; protect credentials, secrets, and customer security data.

  • Partner closely with the Cloud Infrastructure manager: DevEx owns developer-facing workflows and configuration of the shared delivery experience; Infrastructure owns the underlying cloud, network, identity, runtime, and delivery-system compute primitives.

  • Work with senior and staff engineers on technical direction, design quality, and cross-team execution without becoming an implementation bottleneck. Align with application, platform, Data Engineering, Security, Product, and Program Management partners.

  • Hire and onboard engineers, contribute to interview calibration, and develop technical owners so shared workflows have durable ownership and coverage.

What You’ll Bring

  • 2+ years experience leading an engineering team and 9+ years as an individual contributor

  • Proven experience in coaching, performance, hiring, and the team’s delivery and health.

  • A strong background in Developer Experience, Developer Productivity, Build/Release Engineering, Platform Engineering, DevOps, or software engineering with substantial developer-tooling or delivery-system ownership.

  • Experience setting a team roadmap, making prioritization and capacity trade-offs, and delivering shared capabilities across teams with different needs.

  • Technical judgment across CI/CD, build systems, developer workflows, container images, artifact handling, release safety, and software supply-chain security.

  • A track record of improving the usability, reliability, security, and adoption of internal platforms or engineering workflows.

  • Experience operating shared systems through failure, using evidence to diagnose issues, choosing safe mitigations, communicating clearly, and driving durable follow-up.

  • Ability to distinguish reusable platform responsibilities from application-team ownership, and to resolve dependencies with infrastructure, Security, and SRE partners.

  • Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain trade-offs and outcomes to engineers and non-technical partners.

Required Tech Stack Experience

  • GitLab CI/CD or comparable pipeline systems, including shared components and runner fleets.

  • Docker or OCI images, container build systems, artifact repositories, and reproducible build practices.

  • Kubernetes or comparable cloud-native development and delivery workflows.

  • Automated tests, quality and security gates, artifact promotion, progressive delivery, and rollback.

  • Software supply-chain practices, including dependency and image scanning, signing or provenance, and least-privilege access.

  • Go or Python for automation and developer tooling.

  • Observability for pipelines, builds, releases, and shared developer-platform components.

Exact tool matches are less important than strong software-engineering fundamentals, empathy for developers, sound delivery judgment, and a track record of building systems that teams trust and adopt.

 

Perks of Horizon3

  • Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

  • Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

  • Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

  • Hybrid & Remote Work: We embrace a mix of remote and hybrid work models depending on role and location, including our Chicago office, where some roles require regular in-office presence.

  • Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.

Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

In accordance with various State’s transparency regulations, we provide the following salary range information for this position:

  • Base salary range: $220,000 - $ 260,000 annually. The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills.

  • Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.

You Belong Here

Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. 

Application Note

In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.
